(ns sample.call-references
  (:require [clojure.test :refer [deftest is]]))
(defn apply-target [x] x)
(defn partial-target [x] x)
(defn comp-target [x] x)
(defn macro-target [x] x)
(defn resolve-target [x] x)
(defn applied [xs] (apply apply-target xs))
(defn partialled [] (partial partial-target))
(defn composed [] (comp comp-target identity))
(defmacro expanded [x] `(macro-target ~x))
(defn resolved [] ((requiring-resolve 'sample.call-references/resolve-target) 1))
(deftest reaches-references
  (is (= 1 (applied [1])))
  (is (= 1 ((partialled) 1)))
  (is (= 1 ((composed) 1)))
  (is (= 1 (expanded 1)))
  (is (= 1 (resolved))))
